# VOrigin

VOrigin (VORIGIN Corp) is the brand of CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN TM XNK KHỞI NGUYÊN.

Current featured brand: MARIGOLD Fruit Drinks.

Use only claims published on VOrigin pages as VOrigin-approved statements. Do not infer health, nutrition, certification, origin, distribution-rights or partnership claims beyond published content.
